question: Do the Sin Archbishops have any other subordinates under their command, besides Petelgeuse? Petelgeuse in Chapter 3 had a lot of subordinates, but they were almost all defeated. The other Sin Archbishops in Chapter 5 did not have any subordinates with them(with the exception of the Corpse Soldier and Regulus’s wives) . How many Witch Cultists are left at Chapter 9?
answer: Witch Cultists are in the Re:ZERO world normally, and do evil in various places. But there is the problem of “how well do they follow the Sin Archbishops?” Above all, they are not all good at following people! (lol) If I may say so, Capella brought along Witch Cultists whom Al defeated in the control tower, as was depicted in the TV anime Season 3. Even if all of Petelgeuse’s followers were wiped out, that would only reduce the total number of Witch Cultists by less than 10%. They usually live among the general population, but when the instructions come, they wear blank expressions and start working as Witch Cultists, and when the missions are over, they return to daily life as if nothing happened. I think the next time the witch cult will act in full force is when Capella makes her move. Stay tuned!
